title: UFD’s Proposal to Change the Requirement for a Board of Public Works Hearing for Tree Removals.
text:
[OLD BUSINESS - DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE MOTIONS]
UFD’s Proposal to Change the Requirement for a Board of Public Works Hearing for Tree Removals.
Current policy of three or more trees requiring a BPW hearing would change to six or more trees. Heard at
September 9 BPW meeting (continued). Possible motion to send comments to BPW. LINK to letter.
Joanne D’Antonio (5 minutes)
